selected_problem: Fresh main failed its checked-in repository path-index regression: the original bounded exact-path recovery contract ordered core/engine.mjs before README.md before src/main.js, but the later host-locale determinism change replaced locale-aware collation with raw code-unit comparison and changed the order to README.md, core/engine.mjs, src/main.js. This is a directly reproduced regression in an existing test, not a request for a new context architecture.
decision_basis: The failure is present in a checked-in regression on fresh canonical main and historical evidence records the same test as previously passing.

The repair preserves host-locale independence while restoring prior case-insensitive lexical tie-break semantics with deterministic code-unit comparisons; it does not reintroduce String.localeCompare or host collation.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502, so this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.
change: repositoryPathIndex now uses a deterministic folded-text comparator for equal-priority path ordering: lowercase code-unit order first, original code-unit order as a stable tie-break. selectContextPaths and other ordering semantics are unchanged.

validation.focused_tests: 6/6 PASS, 0 skipped: path-index contract, host-locale determinism, bounded path identity and repository-summary path identity

truth_boundary: This restores the checked-in deterministic path-index ordering contract without host-locale dependence. It does not claim a globally optimal repository-context ranking policy, filesystem case/Unicode equivalence, exhaustive repository coverage, parser-grade module semantics, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
